alignfour.title: Three against four — Bring the next Four note to the inspected slot
alignfour.message: aligning the next enabled Four note changes only offset and preserves the inspected slot in one Undo

copy.rhythm-four-here-help: Move Four’s next enabled note onto the inspected slot by changing its offset. Three and both note masks stay put. A Four note already here needs no edit. Undo restores the offset.
